title: Final: .NET beyond Windows
cards/0/task: Walk through the years: Mono (2004), Unity (2005), Xamarin (2011) and the Xamarin acquisition (2016).
cards/1/q: Why did Unity pick Mono over .NET Framework in 2005?
cards/1/options/0: Unity was born on the Mac, and Framework ran only on Windows
cards/1/explain: Microsoft had no cross-platform .NET back then.
cards/2/q: A game is built for iPhone. How does Unity run the C#?
cards/2/options/0: IL2CPP: the code is translated to C++ and machine code ahead of time
cards/2/explain: JIT is not allowed on iOS.
cards/3/q: What did Microsoft do in 2016? Select all that apply.
cards/5/q: Match each term to what it is
cards/6/options/0: To CoreCLR, the runtime of modern .NET
cards/6/explain: Announced in 2022, the move is happening step by step.
cards/7/q: What if there had been no ECMA standards?
cards/7/options/0: Mono, and with it Unity and Xamarin, would have been much harder to build
cards/7/explain: The open spec is what the whole "other" branch of .NET grew from.
